meta.name: frontend
meta.description: MUST USE for frontend/web UI/UX/visual work: building, styling, redesigning pages/components, React setup, performance audits, visual QA, taste, and polish. Routes four rulesets: design taste router and brand references; perfection for Playwright/Chromium Lighthouse/Core Web Vitals; ui-ux-db palettes/fonts/guidelines; designpowers personas/accessibility/critique/handoff; plus curl-only lazyweb real-app-screen research for design direction. Triggers: frontend, UI, UX, design, redesign, styling, layout, animation, motion, premium, luxury, minimal, brutalist, Awwwards, DESIGN.md, mockup, React, Lighthouse, accessibility, WCAG, Core Web Vitals, looks generic, make it pretty, like X brand, lazyweb, design research.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline_en: Build, optimize, and polish frontend UI and interactions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to develop or improve web user interfaces and experiences

howto.what: 当用户提出前端/UI/UX/设计相关请求时，Claude 会按照技能要求加载设计参考、执行性能审计、创建 `DESIGN.md` 文件，并进行视觉 QA，确保产出符合高级设计师标准。
howto.when: 当你提到“前端”、“UI”、“设计”等关键词，或要求页面美化、性能审计、无障碍检查时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个类似Stripe风格的着陆页。
优化这个React组件的性能，并运行Lighthouse审计。
检查这个页面的无障碍性是否符合WCAG标准。
say.note: Claude 会加载设计powers规则集，进行无障碍审查。

howto.what_en: When you make a frontend/UI/UX/design request, Claude loads design references, runs performance audits, creates a DESIGN.md, and performs visual QA to meet senior-designer standards.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention 'frontend', 'UI', 'design', or ask for styling, performance audit, accessibility check, or redesign.

say_en.text: Build a landing page like Stripe's style.
say_en.note: Claude loads brand rules and creates DESIGN.md before implementation.

say_en.text: Optimize this React component and run Lighthouse audit.
say_en.note: Claude loads perfection rules and uses Playwright for audit.

say_en.text: Check this page's accessibility against WCAG.
say_en.note: Claude loads designpowers rules for accessibility review.
